title: The Schmitt Trigger: Why a Comparator Needs Hysteresis
topic: Inverting op-amp with positive feedback creates two thresholds V_TH and V_TL — once the output snaps, the trigger ignores small input wiggles around the original level. Cleans up noisy crossings that a plain comparator chatters on.

beats.narration: A plain comparator chatters when a noisy input crosses the reference. How do you give it a backbone?

elements.content: Noisy crossing → output chatter. Hysteresis is the fix.

beats.narration: Take an op-amp and wire feedback from the output back to the plus input through a resistor divider. That's positive feedback — the opposite of what you used for an amplifier.

elements.content: Op-amp triangle, V_in to the V- input, divider R1/R2 from output to V+
R1, R2 labels; V_in, V_out, V_ref labels at pins
Arrow from output back to V+ highlighted in rose — 'positive feedback'
the output now helps decide what the threshold is

beats.narration: When the output is high, the divider pushes the plus input up — the trip threshold V T H climbs. When the output is low, V plus drops, and the threshold falls to V T L. Two different thresholds for the same circuit.

elements.content: Transfer V_out vs V_in plot with two thresholds marked
Hysteresis loop traces — first the lower edge L→R, then the upper edge R→L

beats.narration: Now sweep the input slowly up then back down. The output sits low until V in passes V T H — only then does it snap up. On the way back, V in must drop all the way to V T L before it snaps back. Two thresholds, one loop, no chatter.

elements.content: V_in vs time scope above, V_out vs time scope below, third pane: V_out vs V_in loop
V_in sweep up and back down (triangle), V_out as square that snaps at V_TH and V_TL
Dot on the loop pane tracking (V_in, V_out) — traces the hysteresis loop
the gap between V_TH and V_TL is the noise the trigger ignores

beats.narration: That gap is the hysteresis band. Any noise smaller than the band can't toggle the output — one clean edge per real crossing.

elements.content: V_TH − V_TL = hysteresis band ≫ noise floor
